result.reason: The added provision meets every preferred insurance requirement and therefore also exceeds the fallback limits. It appropriately directs the duties to TrueLink, applies them throughout the term, and adds no unrelated commercial obligation. The drafting is clear and operative, though the quality score reflects the unexplained numeric rating scale rather than a substantive defect.
